rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that something is certain to happen.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 jeng4

rows.note: Use this when someone is obliged or required to do something.

example.english: You are bound to submit the form today.
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gam1 jat6 gaau1 fan6 biu2

rows.note: Use this for being ready to set off, rather than for specifying a destination or direction.

example.english: We are bound to set off now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 ceot1 faat3 laa3
